summary: Frontend-only visual QA of the 'Midnight & Sunshine' redesign, with a functional smoke test. Viewports: 1920x1080, 1280x800 and 390x844. Roles: worker, employer, admin and the unverified new.worker. Method: screenshots plus a DOM scan in the browser that flags pink/crimson computed colours and text with a contrast ratio below 2.6. WORKING: at 1024px and wider there is a fixed navy side menu (248px, rgb 15,27,45) with the 'hyrz.' brand (white with a sunshine dot). The active item has sunshine text and a 3px inset left bar. Main content starts at x=248 with no overlap. Section tiles render with icons for all 8 worker tiles and 7 employer tiles. The mobile bottom nav is navy with a sunshine active item. The direct chat (.hz-room) sits to the right of the menu (left=248); sending works for both roles. Workchat sending works, and reactions and the reply bar work. Login and logout work in the UI for all 3 roles. The Clock in button is present (desktop). The post-a-shift form opens with 11 fields. Employer Checkouts shows 3 Approve buttons. The payslip PDF downloads (hyrz-payslip-2026-27-week-31.pdf). The unverified worker's verification panel is readable. FAILING: 3 critical, 9 high and about 12 medium/low visual defects (listed below). The worst are: group workchats cover the side menu on desktop; the admin Financial Reports numbers are invisible; the mobile Jobs today-card collapses under the job tabs and covers Clock in; and several headings are navy text on navy backgrounds.

ui_bugs.issue: The group workchat covers the whole screen at 1920 and 1280, so the side menu is hidden behind it. It renders at left=0 and width=1920; elementFromPoint(100,300) returns .workchat-message-list, not the nav. Affects both worker and employer (Riverside Fest Crew, Friday Bar Team). Cause: chat.css:200 'html body #root .app .workchat-conversation:not(.hyrz-one-to-one-chat){z-index:1500!important}' with position:fixed and inset 0. midnight-shell.css only offsets .hz-room by var(--mn-side), not .workchat-conversation. Fix: in the >=1024px media query add '.workchat-conversation:not(.hyrz-one-to-one-chat){left:var(--mn-side)!important;width:auto!important;right:0!important}', or lower the z-index below the nav's 70.

All 12 stat values (Total users 12, Workers 7, Platform fees £215.50, Paid revenue, Outstanding, Pending/Approved/Paid commissions and others) are #EBF5FF on white (contrast 1.10), so they are effectively invisible. Labels are #A9AFA1 on white (contrast 2.25). Screenshot a_fin_1920.jpg.
ui_bugs.selector: main .stats strong / admin financial report cards

ui_bugs.issue: .worker-todays-shift-wrap collapses to height 0 at top=93. The job tabs (top 117–221) are drawn over the Today's shift card, so the title is hidden and the Clock in button (top 191) is covered: elementFromPoint on Clock in does not return the button. The Clock in button is not usable on mobile. Screenshot w_dash_390.jpg.

Navy text on a navy background, so these headings cannot be seen: the H2 'Find work on the go.' (.download-app-copy h2; only 'on the go.' shows) and the footer column headings 'GET IN TOUCH', 'OPPORTUNITIES', 'EXPLORE hyrz' (.hyrz-footer-column h3, color rgb(15,27,45) on navy). Desktop and mobile.

The active tab 'About us' (button.public-about-trigger.active) is white text on #EBF5FF, so it is invisible (empty pale pill at y≈1198). The active carousel indicator 'Home' (small, white on #EBF5FF) is also invisible.
The 'Next 6 weeks' heading is navy on navy (contrast 1.0), leaving a blank space next to 'Show all'.

The selected/today date cell (Wed, Nov 28) is navy text on a navy background, so it is invisible. The legend says 'Orange dates have confirmed shifts', but those dates are now blue. '1 shift' is dark text on blue cells (low contrast).
The count badges on BLOCKED and PENDING VERIFICATION are white text on white/#EBF5FF, so they show as empty white circles (.admin-inbox-unread-count, contrast 1.10).

Each tab row (INBOX/USERS/FINANCIAL REPORTS…, MESSAGES/+NEW MESSAGE/NOTIFICATIONS, WORKERS/ADMINS/EMPLOYERS, ALL/BLOCKED/PENDING) sits on a pure black #000 strip. This is not part of the palette and looks harsh (styles.css lines ~4063, 6346–6414 use background:#000). The MESSAGES / + NEW MESSAGE row is shown twice: once in the black bar and again just below it. Admin pages also put a white box behind the 'Dashboard' / 'Hello, Test' h1 on the off-white page.

The .hz-avatar background is rgb(142,59,94), the old plum. chat/chatUtils.js PALETTE still holds the old palette: '#AD1744' (crimson), '#8E3B5E' (plum), '#B5651D', '#7A4FA0', '#2E8B6E' and others. Inbox list avatars (navy/blue/sunshine) also do not match the chat header avatars (plum or green) for the same person.
On worker job cards, span.instant-pay-badge.unavailable still uses the salmon/pink palette: text rgb(138,45,37), border rgb(244,194,185), pink background. Visible on the dashboard and the Jobs list.

The 'CURRENT SHIFT · Shift 1' callout still uses the old peach background with an orange left border. The 'in cluster' text under the 0 counter is orange-red. The action row is unbalanced: 'Save as template only' spans the full width while 'Review & publish cluster' and 'Private offer' are squeezed to the right, and the disabled publish button is a washed-out blue.

ui_bugs.component: Workchat 'Replying to <name>' quote in own bubble
ui_bugs.issue: 'Replying to Leo Martins' / 'Replying to Priya Shah' is sunshine #FFC93C text on the light blue own-bubble (#DCEBFF), so it is very low contrast. Desktop and mobile.
The '0' count in .favourite-worker-info is #EBF5FF on white, so it is invisible.
The worker 'A' and employer 'S' initials sit at the top of the navy circle instead of the centre (1920, 1280 and 390). On employer 390 the avatar is distorted (oval with a vertical bar).
The pill group overflows its container, so the 'Employers' tab is cut off at the right edge.

At 1920 the form card overlaps the left hero: 'HOSPITALITY · FESTIVALS · RETA…' and 'Staffing, payroll and accountin…' are cut off. At 390 the hero image fills only the left half and the card floats over it. The role-choice cards use a default sans-serif font instead of Outfit/DM Sans.

The Jobs tabs (.job-tabs.job-tabs-squares) are excluded from the new pill style, so they render as flat light-blue rectangles in a 4-column grid. The active tab has navy text-fill on #2272EB (computed color is white, but -webkit-text-fill-color is navy), giving about 3:1 contrast. This is inconsistent with the pill tabs used on Checkouts, Shifts and Funds.

design_issues.screen: Worker sub-pages (Checkouts, Invoices, Finances, Availability, Timetable, Notifications)
issues: The back button (↶) floats in the middle between the h1 and the panel. On employer pages it is left-aligned, and Contact uses a different, larger icon. Make these consistent.
The Checkouts 'Clocked in/Clocked out' boxes use the old warm cream #F7F5F0 instead of the new greys.
The title and timestamp run together without a space ('Switching to hyrz PAYE05/11/2026').
The h1 says 'Hello, Alex' on the Profile and Inbox pages instead of the page name. Admin My account says 'Hello, Test'.
Very small 8–10px labels, a large grey 'T' placeholder box and a lot of empty space. The wide layout is not used well.
Uses the text glyphs ▦ and ○ instead of SVG icons like the worker/employer menus. The sign-out button at the bottom is a lone icon. Admin message cards use a default sans font.

Read ticks on your own bubble sit in a separate strip under the bubble, and reactions are pushed to the far right below. After sending, the list does not scroll fully to the new message (it is cut off at the bottom). Sticky day separators ('MONDAY'/'YESTERDAY') overlap each other and bubbles. The group header title uses a default sans font, not Outfit. The 'You' quote label in direct chat is green (not in the palette).

The verification 'Date of birth' uses the native browser date input (shows US mm/dd/yyyy in a UK app). Admin My account uses the native 'Choose File' input. The Pay & Tax toggle in its off state is nearly invisible (white on white).
Grammar: '1 shifts scheduled'. The employer header sign-out button is white while the worker's is navy (inconsistent). The unread dot overlaps the Dashboard nav icon.
The About section uses a cream background instead of the new off-white #F7F8FA.

action_items: CRITICAL: offset .workchat-conversation (group workchat) by var(--mn-side) at >=1024px so it sits beside the side menu, as .hz-room already does. chat.css:200 forces z-index 1500, fixed, full width.

CRITICAL: fix the admin Financial Reports stat values. #EBF5FF text on white comes from recolor-midnight.js mapping #FCE8EF/#FBE9EE → #EBF5FF, and styles.css has 90 'color:#EBF5FF' declarations. Audit every one whose background is now white or light (also .admin-inbox-unread-count, .favourite-worker-info, .public-about-trigger.active, landing carousel indicator, .shift-type-filter-label).
CRITICAL: on mobile, the worker Jobs today's-shift wrap collapses to height 0 and the job tabs cover the Clock in button. Restore the wrap's height and stacking.
HIGH: fix the navy-on-navy headings: landing .download-app-copy h2 'Find work', .hyrz-footer-column h3, Jobs calendar 'Next 6 weeks', the Timetable selected date cell.
HIGH: replace the pure black #000 admin tab bars with palette colours and remove the duplicated MESSAGES/+NEW MESSAGE row.
HIGH: update chat/chatUtils.js PALETTE (remove #AD1744, #8E3B5E and the other old colours) to navy/blue/sky/sunshine, and match the inbox list avatars.

MEDIUM: recolour .instant-pay-badge.unavailable, the post-shift 'Current shift' callout and the 'in cluster' label. Give the reply quote label in your own bubble a readable colour. Centre the header avatar initial. Stop the mobile inbox tabs overflowing. Fix the auth page hero/card overlap.
LOW: back-button placement, page titles, native date/file inputs, '1 shifts' grammar, job tab pill consistency, admin nav icons.
critical_code_review_comments: The theme is built by overriding the legacy CSS with '#root:not(#mn)'/'#root:not(#hz)' specificity hacks and !important in midnight-shell.css, on top of an 18k-line styles.css that was recoloured by regex. Many of the invisible-text bugs come from that blind hex remap (blush text colour → #EBF5FF while its old crimson background became white). Remapping text colours separately from background colours would avoid this.
midnight-shell.css contains repeated, conflicting rules for the same selectors (.section-tile and .worker-todays-shift-card are each redefined 4–6 times). Consolidate them.
The desktop side-menu offset covers .hz-room but not .workchat-conversation; both chat types need the same handling.

success_rate.frontend: Functional smoke 100% (login/logout ×3, clock-in present on desktop, post-shift form, approve buttons, payslip PDF, direct + workchat send, reactions/reply). Visual QA ~60%: 3 critical, 9 high, ~12 medium/low defects.

seed_data_creation: Sent 2 TEST_ chat messages (workchat Riverside Fest Crew and direct chat with Sam Demo). Re-ran 'cd /app/server && node scripts/seed-demo-data.js' at the end to restore demo data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Log in by fetching POST /api/auth/login in the page, setting localStorage 'hyrz_token', then reloading. Navigation: '.worker-bottom-nav / .employer-bottom-nav / .admin-bottom-nav button' with has_text. Tiles: [data-testid=dashboard-section-<id>]. Inbox rows: .workchat-wa-row. The group workchat composer is a textarea with placeholder 'Write a message…' (unicode ellipsis); the direct chat composer placeholder is 'Type a message'. Admin tabs are role=button with exact uppercase names. A useful check is a DOM scan that computes contrast from computed color / -webkit-text-fill-color against the nearest opaque ancestor background, plus an HSL check for pink. Do not use page.go_back() inside a chat: it leaves the SPA.
rca of the issue: 1) Group workchat covers the menu: chat.css:200 sets z-index:1500 on .workchat-conversation (position fixed, full width), and midnight-shell.css only offsets .hz-room. 2) Invisible pale text: scripts/recolor-midnight.js maps the blush colours #FCE8EF/#FBE9EE to #EBF5FF for both text and backgrounds. Text that was blush on crimson is now #EBF5FF on white. 3) Navy-on-navy: the dark ink colour stayed navy (#0F1B2D) while the section backgrounds were also remapped to navy (landing download section, footer, calendar header, timetable selected cell). 4) Leftover crimson in direct chat avatars: the PALETTE in chat/chatUtils.js is JavaScript, so the CSS recolour script never touched it.
